name: Bakemono Tono
source:
Play as FBI Agent Sam Sawyer as they investigate the murder of Lady Latrelle, the latest in a series of insect homicides in Seattle. Question witnesses, find evidence, and see through time with Sam’s special ability!

[From [url=http://bakemono-tono.tumblr.com/post/93355061726/]official site[/url]]

Development has been canceled.
translation:
扮演FBI探员山姆·索耶，调查西雅图一系列昆虫谋杀案中最新发生的拉特雷尔夫人谋杀案。询问证人，寻找证据，并用山姆的特殊能力看穿时间！

[来自 [url=http://bakemono-tono.tumblr.com/post/93355061726/]官方网站[/url]]

本作已取消开发。
